flows.name: A legal request goes from intake to resolution, with agents handing off to a lawyer (LawVu)
flows.summary: LawVu's LegalOS, in its own terms: requests enter through one front door, agents reason and act inside rules the legal team sets and hand off to a person when it matters; for complex work several agents coordinate with the right approvals.

steps.what: Sends a request (for example an MSA) through LawVu's intake, from any channel.
Captures, triages and routes the request to the right person.
Reason and take action within the rules the legal team sets; for complex work several agents coordinate in order, with approvals.
Takes over when the agents hand off, at the points that matter.
Works through LawVu Assistant in natural language: it creates matters, assigns tasks and triggers workflows ("Ask to Act").
